name: wait-scope
description: Warns when a Claude Code turn edits files outside the scope you set: a short count on the status line, then a list once the turn ends. Never blocks or reverts an edit.

enabled.title: Warn when a turn edits outside the scope
enabled.description: On by default. A status-line count while a turn edits files outside the scope, and a list once it ends. Only a warning: nothing is blocked or undone. Off leaves every turn silent.

globs.title: Files in scope
globs.description: Comma-separated globs, relative to the project root, that a turn's edits should stay inside (src/auth/**, docs). A project's .claude/wait-scope file, one glob per line, wins over this. With neither, the paths your prompt names are only a guess.
